review.body:
<!-- rivetari-judge-review round=1 -->
### Rivetari judge · round 1 · 1 blocking

#### Blocking

**defect: New scroller region has the same name as the section it sits in, which adds a landmark-unique violation** `src/app/cloud/PlanTab.tsx:93`
The enclosing <section aria-labelledby="past-h"> is already a region landmark named "Earlier". The new div also has role="region" and aria-labelledby="past-h", so the page now has two nested region landmarks that are both called "Earlier". The original audit ran best-practice rules (it reported page-has-heading-one), so the same run will now report landmark-unique on this page. The card says to fix only the reported rules, and this adds a new axe failure on a page it was cleaning up. Screen-reader users also hear "Earlier, region" twice in a row.
- **Repro:** Load /cloud/sessions/?athlete=demo-athlete&tab=plan with an athlete whose plan has past items, so `past.length > 0` and the Earlier section renders. The <section aria-labelledby="past-h"> is a region landmark named "Earlier". The new <div className="table-scroll" role="region" aria-labelledby="past-h"> (PlanTab.tsx:93) is a second, nested region also named "Earlier". Run axe-core with best-practice rules enabled: landmark-unique flags both elements as region|Earlier.
- **Fix:** Give the scroller its own name, e.g. replace aria-labelledby="past-h" with aria-label="Earlier practices" (or aria-labelledby pointing to a distinct caption).

#### Acceptance
- A1: unverified — Needs the tool-produced axe screenshots. The code changes look like they address both serious rules.
- A2: unverified — Both scrollers now have tabIndex=0, role=region and a name, and the global :focus-visible should draw the outline. A manual axe, Tab and arrow-key check at 375px is still needed.
- A3: met — Both .new-dot elements dropped aria-label for an sr-only span. The span is clipped, so the dot should look the same; the screenshots confirm this.
- A4: met — The three reported pages pass level={1}. EmptyState still defaults to h2, and new tests cover both levels.
- A5: met — The 6th and 8th th now have sr-only 'Timing, exhale' and 'Depth, exhale'. The text is clipped, so the table looks the same.

<details><summary>2 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- .empty h1 may not match the h2 it replaces `src/app/globals.css:206` — Copy exactly the computed styles of the existing .empty h2 (font size and margin) into .empty h1, or share one selector: `.empty h1, .empty h2 { … }`.
- The sr-only text joins the link name with no separator `src/app/cloud/CoachDashboard.tsx:316` — Put a leading space or a comma in the sr-only text, e.g. ", not opened yet".

</details>

_claude-opus-5-5 · 2 call(s) · Claude reviews, humans merge._

suggestions.title: .empty h1 may not match the h2 it replaces
suggestions.detail: The global h2 is 600 var(--t-15)/1.3, but the new .empty h1 rule uses var(--t-17), and the rest of the global h1 rule (margins, colour, etc.) still applies. Unless a .empty h2 override elsewhere already uses --t-17 and the same box styles, the three empty states will render differently. The constraints allow no visual change beyond the scroller focus outline.
suggestions.repro: Compare before and after screenshots of /cloud/sharing/ as a coach.
suggestions.fix: Copy exactly the computed styles of the existing .empty h2 (font size and margin) into .empty h1, or share one selector: `.empty h1, .empty h2 { … }`.

suggestions.detail: The span sits inside <b> right after the display name, so the link's accessible name may read as "Lena VosNot opened yet" in some screen readers.
suggestions.repro: Inspect the accessible name of the To review link for an unopened session in Chrome DevTools.
suggestions.fix: Put a leading space or a comma in the sr-only text, e.g. ", not opened yet".
